Burkina Faso is in a profound crisis marked by terrorism, food shortages, the negative effects of climate change, social tensions and massive displacement. The project contributes to promoting peace, social cohesion and respect for human rights in Burkina Faso. It primarily funds training courses, awareness-raising campaigns and mediation activities for women accused of witchcraft and socially excluded. The target group is approximately 3,000 people in four regions of the country, predominantly schoolchildren and women.
